o.text: From Proto-Turkic *ād- (“sober, to sober up”), whence also ayılmaq (“to awaken”). Cognate with Karakhanid اَذِغْ (aδïɣ), Turkish ayık, Crimean Tatar ayınıq, Bashkir айыҡ (ayıq), Chuvash урӑ (ură).
Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *yālga- (“to lick”). Cognate with Turkish yalamak.
From French chiffre, via Russian шифр (šifr). Doublet of sıfır.
